title: I've built a techno-fantasy card game
author: Niroooooo
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/bdy44yhs3kgh1.png?width=2144&format=png&auto=webp&s=47264c532ae5b36b5c3d85ee05df01ac7ec36f5a

    Hi All,
    
    This is my second attempt at developing a game, would love to get some feedback.  
    
    In short: Nexus Breach is a browser card game: 120 cards, eight factions, two to four players. Built solo. AI touched every part of it.
    
    You can play vs AI or with Friends. 
    
    
    Claude Code: engine, front end, database. 
    
    Card art: a local Z-Image model in Draw Things, created all the art for free.
    
    Sound: ElevenLabs, 23 special effects. 
    
    
    Music: Suno, five tracks. I wrote down what it must not be (no synthwave, no heroic fanfare, no chiptune) and generated against that rather than a genre.  
    
    The rules are the one part where I had most of the ideas but used Opus to help me test the balance and fairness of the cards. 
    
    
    Here's the link: https://nexusbreach.com
